cases.A: ShopView SV-5319 — Regression Test Checklist (by role)
Purpose: walk through each role one login at a time and verify the permission/behaviour changes from SV-5319.
Each role has its own tab. Work top to bottom. Mark Pass/Fail in column I and put any UI label or surprise in column J.
DEEP  (red)    = test most carefully — pricing visibility and Tech View. Highest risk.
MUST  (amber)  = must test — permission allow/deny and behaviour changes.
Grounding: expected results come from the Custom Roles permission matrix and the developer change-analysis (SV-5319).
Where the exact button label or blocked-state (hidden vs greyed vs error) is not documented, column J says 'confirm in app' —
fill it in on the first run rather than assuming. Items marked SPEC SILENT need product-owner confirmation, not a pass/fail.
Known caveats to keep in mind while testing:
• Service Advisor may display as 'Junior Service Advisor' in the build (spec calls it 'Service Advisor').
• Reverse/delete/void was found blocked when Manage AP/AR is OFF — a suspected bug; note actual behaviour.
• Deleting a return is enabled by Vendor and Order Management: Delete (build behaviour, not in spec).
• The developer analysis covered the changes it listed; ~69 of 386 changed items were uncategorised — not in scope here.
